content: Because the data stem from social media, some text exists that cannot be considered as part of any sentence, such as product links, symbols unrelated to sentences, and space between sentences. These portions were not originally annotated as sentences by the linguists. However, in this work, we treat these portions as individual sentences and tag the first word of each fraction as the sentence boundary.
